summary.name: DeepSeek
summary.one_liner: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI lab's site offering chat with its large language models (such as DeepSeek V4.1 Flash), an API platform, and open-source models including DeepSeek-V4 and DeepSeek-R1.
use_cases: project development with an AI model
summary.what_it_does: The page is the landing page for DeepSeek (深度求索), an AI research company focused on general-purpose foundation models. It links to a web chat interface, an app (scannable QR code), a DeepSeek Harness desktop app, an API Platform with API docs, and a Downloads and Join Us section. It announces that DeepSeek V4.1 Flash was updated to version V4.1-Flash-1017 with improved project development capabilities, and that the API now supports web search and fetch. The page also mentions DeepThink and Search modes for chat. The meta description names open-source releases DeepSeek-V4 and DeepSeek-R1.
notable: Open-source frontier models such as DeepSeek-V4 and DeepSeek-R1
DeepThink reasoning and Search modes in chat
API now supports web search and fetch
caveats: Pricing details for the API are not stated on the page
Platform list for the mobile app is inferred only from the 'Scan to get DeepSeek App' prompt; iOS and Android are not named
